policy_summary: Non-clean audited theorem/no-go/open-gate claims surfaced under one of three policies: (a) all current one-hop deps are retained-grade and at least one was non-retained at audit time; (b) the audit cited runner_artifact_issue and the runner file hash has changed since the audit_state_snapshot was taken; or (c) the audit requested complete runner stdout and a usable source-bound cache falls above the legacy 6k limit but within the current 20k head+tail transport budget.
